3 people booked at Mississippi County facility on July 25
At least three people were booked at a Mississippi County, Ark., facility on July 25, 2026.
The "Other" category appeared in two listed-charge entries across the bookings; the "Warrant" and "Traffic" categories appeared in one each.
Booking records show charges listed at the time of booking. The individuals named have not been convicted of any charge based on this record.
